title: LLM-derived sequence ordering rules from step descriptions and public process references

feature_hints.name: operation_family
feature_hints.description: Classify each STEP into clean, lithography, etch, deposition, implant, anneal, measurement, CMP, test, logistics, backside, or passivation.

feature_hints.name: mask_level
feature_hints.description: Parse N from ALIGN MASK LEVEL N or EXPOSE LITHO LEVEL N. Useful for monotonic lithography-level checks.

feature_hints.name: block_state
feature_hints.description: Infer current macro block from local context: prefix, pre-clean, family prep, litho cycle, ILD, via, metal, passivation, backside, final inspection, test, suffix.

feature_hints.name: distance_since_clean
feature_hints.description: Count steps since last clean/HF/dry/anneal/surface-prep event. Useful before deposition or oxidation.

feature_hints.name: distance_since_develop
feature_hints.description: Count steps since last DEVELOP PHOTORESIST or DEVELOP PAD WINDOW. Useful before patterned etch or implant.

feature_hints.name: measurement_subject
feature_hints.description: Map MEASURE steps to the operation they probably verify, e.g. oxide thickness after oxidation, via CD after via etch, sheet resistance after implant/anneal.

rules.title: Clean or surface preparation should precede oxidation, epitaxy, and deposition
local_basis: MOSFET_Longdescr.csv: EPITAXIAL DEPOSITION mentions epitaxial growth parameters.
MOSFET_longdescription_parameters.csv: HF DIP, RCA cleans, and epitaxy prep appear immediately before epitaxy.
IC_longdescription_parameters.csv: THERMAL OXIDATION follows cleans and has dry O2 furnace parameters.
rules.future_solution_hint: Use as a validator check and as a next-step reranking penalty when a deposition candidate appears after a long non-clean context.

rules.title: Lithography has a stable internal order
local_basis: MOSFET_Longdescr.csv: SPIN COAT PHOTORESIST records spin speed and resist thickness.
MOSFET_Longdescr.csv: EXPOSE LITHO LEVEL 1 mentions dose and focus.
MOSFET_Longdescr.csv: DEVELOP PHOTORESIST reveals the intended pattern.
rules.future_solution_hint: Constrain completions so a lithography block is generated as a coherent unit, not one step at a time.

rules.title: Patterned etch or implant should follow developed resist or an opened window
local_basis: MOSFET_Longdescr.csv: OXIDE ETCH etches oxide in patterned areas.
IC_longdescription_parameters.csv: OXIDE ETCH uses RIE after develop and pattern inspection.
IGBT_longdescription_parameters.csv: implant steps follow window/opening steps.
rules.future_solution_hint: Strong anomaly rule and strong next-step blocker.

rules.title: After etch or patterned transfer, strip resist and clean before the next deposition-sensitive block

ordered_or_near_ordered: CLEAN AFTER * or CLEAN PAD OPENING

local_basis: MOSFET_Longdescr.csv: STRIP PHOTORESIST removes remaining photoresist after etch.
MOSFET_Longdescr.csv: CLEAN AFTER ETCH removes post-etch residues.
IC_longdescription_parameters.csv: STRIP PHOTORESIST and CLEAN AFTER ETCH follow etch examples.
rules.future_solution_hint: Use as a completion prior. Do not make it absolute for all blanket spacer etches unless local grammar confirms it.

rules.title: Implant steps should be followed by anneal or diffusion activation
local_basis: MOSFET_Longdescr.csv: RAPID THERMAL ANNEAL activates dopants and repairs implant damage.
MOSFET_longdescription_parameters.csv: IMPLANT WELL is followed by DRIVE IN DIFFUSION and RAPID THERMAL ANNEAL.
IGBT_longdescription_parameters.csv: implant blocks are followed by activation anneals.
rules.future_solution_hint: Useful for suffix completion: after an implant, rank anneal/drive-in highly.

rules.title: Measurement steps should follow the operation they measure
local_basis: MOSFET_Longdescr.csv: MEASURE EPITAXY THICKNESS follows epitaxial deposition.
IC_longdescription_parameters.csv: MEASURE OXIDE THICKNESS follows THERMAL OXIDATION.
IGBT_longdescription_parameters.csv: MEASURE SHEET RESISTANCE has different expected ranges in different implant contexts.
rules.future_solution_hint: Use as a soft score. Measurements can be optional, so absence is not necessarily invalid.

rules.title: CMP should follow dielectric/metal deposition or via fill
local_basis: generation_rules.md: CMP rule already exists.
IC_longdescription_parameters.csv: CMP DIELECTRIC follows ILD deposition and densification.
IGBT_longdescription_parameters.csv: CMP INTERLAYER DIELECTRIC is described as oxide slurry planarization.
rules.future_solution_hint: Keep as a strong anomaly feature and a completion-order prior.

rules.title: Via processing should move from via litho/etch to clean, barrier/seed, fill, CMP, and resistance measurement
requires_order_when_present: STRIP and CLEAN AFTER VIA ETCH
DEPOSIT METAL SEED or DEPOSIT TUNGSTEN SEED
FILL VIA METAL or FILL VIA TUNGSTEN
CMP METAL or CMP VIA FILL
MEASURE CONTACT RESISTANCE or MEASURE VIA RESISTANCE
local_basis: generation_rules.md: VIA_BLOCK defines barrier, seed, fill, CMP, measure.
IC_longdescription_parameters.csv: via etch, strip, clean, and via metallization steps appear in this order.
rules.future_solution_hint: Useful as a block-level automaton for completion.

rules.title: Metal interconnect patterning should deposit metal before metal lithography and etch
requires_order_when_present: DEPOSIT METAL 1 or DEPOSIT TOP METAL
METAL ETCH or METAL ETCH DRY
local_basis: generation_rules.md: METAL_BLOCK and metal etch rules.
IC_longdescription_parameters.csv: metal lithography repeats the coat/bake/expose/develop sequence before etch.
rules.future_solution_hint: Useful for detecting reversed metal operations and for retrieving correct suffix blocks.

rules.title: Passivation should be deposited and cured before pad opening and final electrical tests
requires_order_when_present: DEPOSIT PASSIVATION or DEPOSIT PASSIVATION LAYER
MEASURE PASSIVATION THICKNESS or MEASURE PASSIVATION QUALITY
OPEN PAD WINDOW or OPEN BOND PAD WINDOW
PASSIVATION ETCH or PASSIVATION ETCH PAD OPENING
local_basis: generation_rules.md: passivation block and test-before-passivation forbidden rule.
MOSFET_longdescription_parameters.csv: passivation measurement and pad opening steps appear late in the flow.
rules.future_solution_hint: Strong anomaly rule. Also helps completion near the 80 percent cut point.

rules.title: Wafer sort and yield analysis should happen before lot release and shipment
requires_order_when_present: PARAMETRIC TEST or ELECTRICAL PARAMETRIC TEST
LOT RELEASE or FINAL LOT RELEASE
local_basis: generation_rules.md: TEST_SUITE and SUFFIX define the terminal order.
training_data variants: sequences end with release and SHIP LOT.
rules.future_solution_hint: Use as a hard terminal constraint in any completion generator.

rules.title: Repeated step names need local context to choose the right description or parameters
problem_examples: SPIN COAT PHOTORESIST appears multiple times for different mask levels.
SOFT BAKE and DEVELOP PHOTORESIST appear in several lithography cycles.
MEASURE THICKNESS can mean initial wafer thickness or backside/post-grind thickness.
MEASURE SHEET RESISTANCE can have different expected ranges after different implants.
local_basis: MOSFET_longdescription_parameters.csv contains repeated THERMAL OXIDATION and repeated lithography rows.
IGBT_longdescription_parameters.csv contains repeated MEASURE SHEET RESISTANCE rows with different expected ranges.
IC_longdescription_parameters.csv repeats SPIN COAT PHOTORESIST and DEVELOP PHOTORESIST for different cycles.
rules.future_solution_hint: Do not build a naive dictionary from STEP to one parameter row. Use an ordered per-family reference sequence alignment or block-aware matching.
